reason: Build failed with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading tap) from NodeSchemePlugin at next.config.js:165. NodeSchemePlugin was trying to tap resolverFactory.hooks.resolve which is undefined in Next.js 15.5.9s webpack. Fix: removed the NodeSchemePlugin entirely along with the node: protocol handling code. Since undici and @napi-rs/canvas are already in serverExternalPackages, webpack never processes their node: imports in browser builds.
